description: Does the researched plan leave a choice only the app's owner should make? Hint line at the post-research gate; may only raise an autonomy level.
instructions: An agent has researched a change to a native iOS app and summarised its plan. Does the plan leave a choice only the app's owner should make: options or trade-offs that no existing pattern, recorded owner decision, web-dashboard behaviour or Apple guideline already settles?

criteria.true: Two or more reasonable options remain and nothing on record picks between them
criteria.false: The plan has one sensible answer, or an existing rule, decision, parity or guideline settles it

output: Hint line at the post-research gate. p>=0.5 says the owner's pick is likely needed: L2 (policy or design per the gate). It never lowers a level; a no or the band says nothing.
evidence: contracts/jev/derived/measurements.md, decision-gate corpus 2026-11-02: AUC 0.999, p>=0.5 precision 0.984, recall 0.926 (test split 124 of 165)
